archetypes.name: dyn-flag-contract
archetypes.rationale: Compressed normative design flag prose must preserve parser and threshold contracts.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the changed flags.md prose against design argv behavior and plan-size threshold contracts. Focus on missing public flags, defaults, run-params keys, rejected legacy flags, and wording that weakens normative behavior while compressing prose. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: dyn-closure-ratchet
archetypes.rationale: The regenerated closure baseline must lock only the intended design shrink.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect python/skill-closure-baseline.json with the markdown change. Confirm the design closure metrics shrink consistently, the implement row stays unchanged, and the committed baseline matches a fresh scan. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
